items.title: Son of Israeli ambassador to US 'seriously injured' in West Bank ramming attack
items.description: The son of Israel's ambassador to the US has reportedly been seriously injured in a ramming attack in the occupied West Bank.

items.title: Netherlands to return to Eurovision as it drops boycott over Israel participation
items.description: The Netherlands will return to the Eurovision Song Contest in 2027 after abandoning a boycott over Israel's participation.

items.title: British businessman jailed over illegal arms deals to war zones worth millions
items.description: A British businessman and an adviser to a quango funded by the UK government have each been jailed for 16 years after brokering illegal arms deals to send fighter jets and weapons to war zones.

items.title: At least 11 dead in mass shooting at house party in South Africa
items.description: At least 11 people have been killed in a mass shooting at a house party in South Africa.
